annotations.ae_shared_affect: There's a kind of loneliness in that choice, and I feel it too

annotations.ce_understood_harm: Their five years would be a heavy thing to carry

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: That kind of trust, even unspoken
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: them choosing silence without knowing what I'll do. That kind of trust

annotations.ae_shared_affect: That sadness isn't just mine, it feels shared.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: like I was seeing my own fear reflected back

annotations.ae_shared_affect: it saddens me knowing they're afraid too
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I care what happens to them
